description: Get mail analytics time series. Get an account-wide time series for a single metric — sent, delivered, scans (QR/link views), or open_rate — bucketed by day or week. Missing buckets are filled with zeroes so the series is continuous. For "scans", each point also includes secondary_value (total scans vs unique properties). Retrieves data without changing records or spending credits.

days.description: Number of days back from today when no date range is given (1-365, default 30)

end_date.description: End of the date range (ISO, defaults to now).

group_by.description: Bucket size for each data point (default day)

metric.description: Metric to chart over time (default sent)

start_date.description: Start of the date range (ISO). Overrides "days" when provided.

name: dealmachine_get_mail_analytics_timeseries
